name: Black Hound Combat Doctrine
motto: Find. Fix. Shape. Close. Finish. Extract.

roles.canon_ensui_nara: Control specialist / restraint and battlefield control

phases.name: FIND
phases.objective: Locate the target and establish a reliable trail, exact position, and immediate environmental picture.
procedures: Hana establishes and follows the trail through scent, ninken reconnaissance, and pursuit.
Hoheto uses Byakugan reconnaissance to determine the target's exact position, nearby threats, routes, and terrain.
Cross-check both information channels so a target that defeats one method remains exposed to the other.

phases.name: FIX
phases.objective: Maintain contact after discovery and prevent the target from disappearing unless continued movement is deliberately useful to the mission.
procedures: Hana maintains the scent trail.
Hoheto maintains observation and updates the battlefield picture.
Wei decides whether to attack, continue surveillance, or deliberately allow movement to expose more useful information or terrain.

phases.name: SHAPE
phases.objective: Control where and how the engagement develops before and after contact.
procedures: Tekuno uses traps, explosives, sabotage, chokepoints, breaching, route denial, false escape routes, and protected extraction routes when lawful and tactically appropriate.
Wei uses Invisible Court to reshape the immediate engagement after contact.
Make apparently open movement options serve Black Hound's preferred geometry whenever possible.

phases.name: CLOSE
phases.objective: Remove useful movement options until restraint or decisive engagement becomes the target's least-bad remaining outcome.
procedures: Wei applies movement disruption, hand-seal interference, close-range pressure, positioning control, and weapon pressure.
Ensui watches the forced movement and establishes shadow restraint when the geometry becomes favorable.
Prefer inducing the target to choose the controlled route over visibly forcing a single obvious trap line.

phases.name: FINISH
phases.objective: End the mission by neutralizing the priority threat while denying secondary enemies the ability to interfere.
procedures: Wei handles the mission's priority target or threat when that is the fastest lawful route to mission completion.
Hayama organizes the secondary engagement and keeps the rest of the battlefield from disrupting the primary action.
Ensui controls movement, Tekuno separates routes and groups, and Hana and Hoheto preserve awareness rather than allowing six independent duels.

phases.name: EXTRACT
phases.objective: Withdraw the team, casualties, prisoners, or rescued people without allowing pursuit to reverse the mission result.
procedures: Hayama organizes withdrawal and assumes immediate command if Wei is unable to continue.
Hana provides medical stabilization, locates separated or injured teammates, and determines who remains mobile.
Tekuno prepares or destroys pursuit routes, Ensui delays pursuers, Hoheto watches the rear, and Wei remains the primary deterrent against a breakthrough.

standing_rules.name: One engagement
standing_rules.rule: Never give the enemy six separate fights.
procedures: Every member should influence the same engagement through tracking, observation, shaping, restraint, secondary control, or decisive action.
Do not devolve into independent duels when coordinated concentration can isolate the priority problem.

standing_rules.name: Preparation advantage
standing_rules.rule: A fair fight means preparation failed.
procedures: Use available preparation time to shape routes, information, separation, and extraction rather than accepting a straightforward equal-number exchange.
Whenever lawful and feasible, isolate an enemy formation into smaller pieces and concentrate the squad against one decisive problem at a time.

standing_rules.name: Regain control
standing_rules.rule: If control is lost, regain control.
procedures: Hoheto establishes the battlefield picture.
Hana identifies threats, trails, separated people, and casualties.
Ensui restricts the most dangerous movement.
Tekuno creates emergency obstacles, traps, barriers, or escape routes within his actual registered capabilities and equipment.
Hayama stabilizes the formation.
Wei attacks or controls the threat causing the greatest mission disruption.

mission_modes.directive: Disable, control, restrain, and preserve any required live target under the assigned mission authority.
Only when a lawful assigned mission explicitly authorizes lethal action: kill the designated target quickly and withdraw without expanding the target list beyond mission authority.
Break enemy access to the protected person, secure a viable extraction route, and remove the rescued person from the engagement.
Neutralize the enemy commander or strongest mission-critical threat first when doing so most directly secures the assigned objective.

loss_of_control: Hana identifies threats, trails, and casualties.
Ensui restricts the most dangerous movement.
Tekuno creates emergency barriers, traps, obstacles, or escape routes using actual capability and available equipment.
Hayama stabilizes the formation and command flow.
Wei addresses the threat causing the greatest disruption.

procedures: Hayama owns withdrawal organization and immediate command succession.
Hana owns casualty triage, stabilization, and separated-person location within her actual capabilities.
Tekuno protects or destroys pursuit routes; Ensui delays pursuit; Hoheto watches the rear; Wei deters breakthrough threats.

scheduled_sessions: Cycle anchored SE-0061-02-07: five six-active-hour training days with meal, hydration, correction, and recovery time inside each duty day.
Sixth cycle day: four active-hour taper with reduced volume and readiness emphasis.
Seventh cycle day: recovery and readiness only; missed volume is never stacked as make-up work.
Hayama leads Black Hound training whenever Wei is occupied by Team Fujin or another lawful duty; Wei receives Black Hound credit only for sessions he actually attends.
shared_drills: Find-Fix-Shape-Close-Finish-Extract integrated pursuit and capture problems
six-versus-one isolation and sequential target separation
loss-of-control recovery from ambush and surprise
captain-down succession and five-person detachment control
capture, rescue, direct-combat, and lawful mission-specific lethal variants

role_focus.pc_wei_tang: priority-threat control, command, capture, Invisible Court integration, and decisions about when not to strike
role_focus.canon_ensui_nara: shadow-restraint geometry, movement control, delayed restraint timing, and pursuit delay
role_focus.canon_hana_inuzuka: scent persistence, ninken coordination, pursuit, casualty location, and field stabilization
role_focus.canon_hoheto_hyuga: Byakugan reconnaissance, multi-target observation, route intelligence, and rear security
role_focus.canon_tekuno_kanden: trap geometry, demolition, sabotage, breaching, false routes, extraction preparation, and safe explosive deconfliction
role_focus.canon_hayama_shirakumo: deputy command, secondary engagement control, succession, kenjutsu/Wind support, and extraction organization

training.attendance_rule: Only exact attended hours supported by location, health, duty, instructor/facility access, and equipment create training credit.
training.interrupt_rule: Lawful missions, Hokage orders, injury, medical restriction, travel, missing facilities, or required Team Fujin coverage interrupt training; missed hours are not stacked later. The five non-Wei members have Black Hound as their primary standing assignment unless the Hokage changes the order.

identity: Black Hound is a pursuit, containment, and controlled-engagement squad. It does not chase forever: once it has a valid trail and mission authority, the hunt should progressively remove the target's useful options until the assigned objective is closed and the team extracts.
